capabilities: Move the tab bar to the left or right side of the editor pane
Collapse the tab bar to icons or title initials via a command or setting
Choose placement for the sidebar toggle (native, note header, or bottom of the tab bar)
Show or hide optional tab icons and the collapse/expand button
extras: Not in the community plugin store; installation requires BRAT (beta plugin installer). Development checks need Node 22.6+ and the Obsidian CLI.
problem: Obsidian only shows note tabs in a horizontal bar at the top, with no native way to stack them vertically beside the editor.

relations.evidence: Install and enable BRAT through the Community Plugins

summary: Vertical tab bar that moves note tabs from the top of the editor pane to a collapsible column on the left or right side.
